stages.english: For linear search, inspect array elements one at a time until you find the target or run out of elements. The array need not be sorted, and in the worst case the work grows linearly with its length, O(n).
stages.chinese: For linear search, inspect array elements one at a time until you find the target or run out of elements. The array need not be sorted, and in the worst case the work grows linearly with its length, O(n).

stages.english: For binary search on a sorted array, compare the target with the middle element and continue only in the half that can still contain it. With constant-time access to array elements, the worst-case number of comparisons grows logarithmically, O(log n); without sorted order, discarding a half is unjustified.
stages.chinese: For binary search on a sorted array, compare the target with the middle element and continue only in the half that can still contain it. With constant-time access to array elements, the worst-case number of comparisons grows logarithmically, O(log n); without sorted order, discarding a half is unjustified.

stages.english: Selection sort repeatedly finds the smallest value in the remaining unsorted region and moves it to the next output position. Its repeated scans give quadratic running time, O(n^2), even if the input array already happens to be sorted.
stages.chinese: Selection sort repeatedly finds the smallest value in the remaining unsorted region and moves it to the next output position. Its repeated scans give quadratic running time, O(n^2), even if the input array already happens to be sorted.

stages.english: Merge sort divides an array into smaller parts, recursively sorts them, and merges the sorted parts by comparing their next available elements. For the usual comparison-based array algorithm, the worst-case running time is O(n log n).
stages.chinese: Merge sort divides an array into smaller parts, recursively sorts them, and merges the sorted parts by comparing their next available elements. For the usual comparison-based array algorithm, the worst-case running time is O(n log n).
